title: Review test · Unit 2 · Stories worth telling

fn.en: Show control of Unit 2: narrative forms, sequencing and story language.

can.en: I can use the past forms and the time linkers, and tell and react to a story.

items.q: While he ___ for the path, he fell into a stream.
When they arrived, the train ___ already.
She ___ into the water and broke her arm.
Teams of people ___ for him all that week.
___ the balloon landed, the story was already on television.
___ she heard the news, she phoned her sister.
Nobody checked the story ___ a week later.
___ reporters were interviewing the family, the boy said too much.

items.from: The balloon landed. Immediately after that, the story went live.
items.cue: Join it with AS SOON AS. Begin: As soon as…
items.a: As soon as the balloon landed the story went live
alt: As soon as the balloon landed, the story went live

items.from: They arrived at eight. The train left at half past seven.
items.cue: Use ALREADY + the past perfect. Begin: When they arrived…
items.a: When they arrived the train had already left
alt: When they arrived, the train had already left

items.r: a story invented to make people believe something false
the facts that show something is true
two things happening together by chance
be unable to move out of a place
say nothing about something you know

items.s: The police were ___ within the hour.
___, a doctor was sitting two rows behind us.
He ___ for twenty-four days on water and barbecue sauce.
Halfway home I ___ that I had left my bag on the train.
The photograph ___ for three days before anybody checked it.

items.x: So then she opened the box.
In the end, nobody was hurt.
